title: Fleet and parts in the core
goal: The core records drones, their part slots and drone models as NERV does
acceptance: The drones, drone_parts, drone_models and drone_model_links data and their operations (add, get by id or name, list drones; set, get and list parts; part categories, default quad positions, category and position normalisation, one live part per slot; add, list and link drone models) move from NERV's src/fleet.ts into src/fpv-core with no NERV imports, behaviour unchanged
NERV's test/fleet.test.ts cases for these areas are carried over or rewritten with invented drones; storage follows the battery core's choice (F-005-T02)
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A behaviour difference from NERV's FPV pack is recorded and goes to the owner before it lands

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: about 300 lines of store code and 160 lines of tests in NERV, ported next to the battery core. Not a measurement.
